source.title: EU sourcing notes for the V4 BOM: EU-warehouse suppliers + customs traps (info)
source.body:
Sharing notes from mapping the PrintNC / LowRider / MPCNC BOM to suppliers that ship from EU warehouses — relevant for anyone sourcing the V4 parts list from Europe.

Key findings from doing my own EU build:
- US-direct orders (control boards, ballscrews, kits) end up +40–50% delivered once customs/VAT handling and shipping are added. EU-warehouse orders clear in 3–10 days with zero customs.
- The PrintNC steel kits sold in DE have been sold out for months; local steel merchants cutting per your section list are the practical fallback.
- Recurring ordering traps seen across build threads: 1605 vs 1610 ballscrew end machining, anti-backlash nut handedness mismatch, rail length vs travel mismatch, plate thickness vs gantry design revision, PSU current vs parallel stepper sets, and missing metric fastener assortments.
- Per-build quantity tables (X/Y/Z axes, 1015/1501/2006-class variants) mapped to PL/DE/CZ/ES warehouse suppliers.

Full free list (maintained, includes traps and a 48-hour ordering plan):
https://gist.github.com/estovisioncontact-bit/d80d74146b9ea5b9ebd7586559b130a2
Web version: https://estovisioncontact-bit.github.io/cnc-sourcing-pl-eu/

I compiled this while sourcing my own build — the guide is free; there's an optional paid custom-research service if maintainers or users want country-specific supplier quotes. Happy to contribute an "EU suppliers" section directly into this repo/wiki if that's preferred over an external link.
